messages:
oliver: Thinking out loud — can we add a single-click 'Generate API key' flow in the console? Need clarity on defaults: project-scoped key vs org-scoped key, default quota, and whether we surface ephemeral tokens.

maria: I vote project-scoped by default. Org keys are risky unless tied to billing/admin perms. projects map cleanly to billing units.

sam: agree default = project, but UI should make org-level explicit with a warning and require a role (billing/admin). also show effective quota (requests/min, tokens/day) up front.

carla: audit + rotation concerns: if we add org keys we need per-key audit logs + last-used timestamps. also prefer ephemeral keys for CI/service accounts (ttl selectable).

ben: API design thought: new endpoint to create keys + optional delegation to service accounts. rough sketch:

```
POST /v1/keys
{
  "name": "infra-deploy-key",
  "scope": "project", // or "org"
  "roles": ["inference:invoke"],
  "quota": {"tokens_per_day": 500000},
  "ttl_seconds": 0 // 0 = long-lived, >0 ephemeral
}
```
Response returns key metadata + raw secret once.

maria: +1 for explicit ttl. But for org keys set a max ttl (e.g., 30d) and require 2FA or owner consent for long-lived.

dave: telemetry: we need token-level metrics in Console (cost, latency, error-rate). surface top-5 keys by spend and allow pausing a key from the UI.

infra-bot: note: adding per-key quota enforcement requires changes in routing layer — we currently only enforce per-project quotas. will need a fast lookup (key->quota) in the hot path.

oliver: good to know. fallback behavior question: if a key exceeds its quota, should we auto-fallback to org quota or reject? my instinct = reject and return 429 with actionable message.

sam: reject + include a link to 'request quota increase' for org admins. avoid automatic fallback — it's surprising.

carla: migration: for existing keys we should default to project-scoped and set a reasonable quota (based on recent 30d usage), mark keys >90d old as "rotate recommended".

ben: also consider a 'policy template' picker in the modal (e.g., "low-cost inference", "high-throughput", "read-only embeddings"). that lets customers pick prefilled role+quota combos.

devx-bot: design doc draft: https://redwood.internal/designs/keys-console-authz (added sketch + flows)

dave: for Private deployments we need KMS/HSM-backed secrets and optional never-exported keys. call this out in API with storage="kms|hsm|platform" flag.

maria: UX: the modal should have: name, scope (project/org), roles checkboxes, quota slider (tokens/day), ttl radio (ephemeral vs long-lived), policy templates, and an advanced section for KMS/HSM.

oliver: sounds good. next steps: ben to iterate API proto + sam/maria to mock modal, infra to estimate effort for quota lookup. who wants to own migration plan?

carla: I can own migration plan. will need a script to compute suggested quotas and a phased rollout (UI opt-in -> auto-apply -> mandatory rotation window).

ben: i'll stub the API today. will post example responses and error codes (429 payload shape) here.

infra-bot: FYI I'll open infra ticket for routing/lookup changes once ben posts API. ETA on ticket: 2d.

oliver: thanks all — let's reconvene after mocks + API draft. :thumbsup:
